run_main: run the pre-trained PPO agent on the minitaur reactive environment and log total reward
load_config: load the PPO policy configuration from a log directory using utility.load_config
create_simple_ppo_policy: create a SimplePPOPolicy agent with a TensorFlow session, environment, network, and checkpoint path
get_action: get an action from the trained PPO agent given a list of environment observations
env_step: step the minitaur reactive environment with an action and return observation, reward, and done flag
